module: Noise effect: adds to data.res.pos a random offset (± factor/2 per axis) renewed every 0.1 s. Hidden mode, not a filter in the isFilter sense. Returns a constructor.

init.desc: Prepares the offset; each call forces a new draw on the first update.

factor.desc: total noise amplitude in meters (0.2 by default, or the existing self.factor)

update.desc: Adds the current offset to data.res.pos.
